decisions.statement: The index is repaired in place rather than built beside the index and swapped in.
A file the build writes is put in place by renaming rather than by copying.
A file already with the lines the pages imply is left alone.
The body an entry file has is its lines closed by a line end.
An entry file holds one line for each entry.
That body is spelled here once for the file written and the file compared.
A filing is answered as that body under the path the filing sits at.
A filing with no line is answered as a path with no body.
A path answered that way is read against the repository root.
A filing beside a page is answered under its own path rather than the index's.
What a filing leaves a file holding is worked out here for a write and a read.
An entry file a filing names is written by laying that filing over what is there.
A line withdrawn that the file does not hold leaves that file as it was.
A line coming that the file already holds is held once.
A file is laid down against the entries one index has.
A file is taken away against the entries every index has.
A file the pages no longer imply is found by reading the whole index rather than one index's folder.
A file the pages no longer imply is taken away.
A folder left holding nothing goes with the file taken away.
A build putting nothing in place is answered for as fully as a build writing files.
Where the index stands is derived from the repository root given here.
A path under the index that no entry names is taken away, whatever it is named.
A repair names the index it writes into and how many of that index's files it wrote.
That naming goes onto a list the repair's caller hands in.
That naming is written as each file is written rather than once the repair finishes.
The file a repair has in hand is named there until that file is written.
Taking files away is named there the way laying files down is.
A repair writing no file names nothing there.
Nothing here decides whether a refresh should run.
Nothing here says in words the change a refresh made.
No mark says an index is whole, and nothing here writes one.

definition: the index reconciled against what the pages say, file by file
